question: Select the most appropriate option to fill blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is Option (4) i.e. '**Classified**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "Classified" is the term used when specifying or categorizing things into different categories or classes based on shared characteristics.
 
• In the context of biological and zoological sciences, species are often divided into subspecies or categories based on genetic, geographic, and phenotypic criteria, which fits the context of the passage describing the categorization of tigers into subspecies.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Classified**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Declared", "Restricted", and "Generalized" do not accurately convey the process of scientific categorization or division into subspecies.

Complete Passage is: Among the largest species of cats in the world, tigers are powerful hunters with (1)Sharp teeth, strong jaws and agile bodies. They range across Asia from Russia all the way to Sumatra and mainland Southeast Asia. Researchers still have much to learn (2) About these beautiful, endangered (3) Cats.

There is currently one recognized species of tiger, Panthera tigris. Scientists have further (4) Classified the tiger into nine subspecies: the extinct Bali, Caspian and Javan subspecies, and the living Malayan, Sumatran, South China, Indochinese, Bengal and Amur (or Siberian) subspecies. Of these six subspecies, AZA-accredited zoos currently manage three: Amur, Malayan, and Sumatran. The Smithsonian's National Zoo and Conservation Biology Institute is home to Sumatran and Amur tigers; Sumatran tigers are (5) ________ as Critically Endangered on the International Union for Conservation of Nature's Red List, and Amur tigers have been classified as Endangered.
